OCR API â€” PDF to Excel Conversion
Endpoint:
Note: Use the local proxy at 127.0.0.1:5050. It forwards uploads from this browser to 45.64.170.8:8001 and avoids browser CORS/mixed-content blocks.
AI Classification Learning
The AI learns your clients' account-code patterns (e.g. "500- = Revenue for this client") from confirmed classifications. If a wrong classification ever gets learned, reset it here rather than re-confirming every affected account by hand.
Sub-Category Lists
Define your own list of sub-categories (e.g. Fixed Asset types, Current Asset types) shown in the Trial Balance's Sub-Category dropdown.
Sub-Category Setup
Pick which classification's sub-category list to edit. Add your own categories or remove ones you don't use -- this is what shows in the Trial Balance Sub-Category dropdown once that classification is selected.
Note Reference Setup
Each schedule gets a note reference (e.g. "Note 5" or "e.") shown wherever it appears -- AI Mapping, Balance Sheet, and Profit & Loss -- so it's easy to trace between the statements, the notes, and the tax computation. Defaults follow standard Malaysian statutory account ordering; override any of them below.
